about: Per-room-type loot hooks (docs/sandbox/INTERIORS.md): a room's loot id to a table in Constructs/Loot.json. Every room of a type rolls from the same table, so a medical bay holds medical things and an armoury guns, ammunition and weapon parts. PROVISIONAL: Loot.json has faction tables only, so every hook points at 'trader' until per-room tables are written; null leaves the containers empty.
